post_clip.description: Two individuals (one in orange shirt, one in white shirt) are engaged in close physical contact near a shelf; the person in white appears to be leaning over or being restrained while the person in orange closely maneuvers around them, with hands near the waist/hip area—consistent with potential shoplifting (concealing items) or an assault. No staff or other customers intervene, and the interaction persists across multiple frames without normal shopping behavior.

The person in the orange shirt appears to be concealing items under their clothing or in a bag while interacting with the person in white near the shelf; their posture and hand movements suggest possible shoplifting—repeated bending, reaching into pockets/bag, and close proximity to merchandise without clear legitimate browsing behavior.

A person in a white shirt (center-right) is leaning over the counter and appears to be concealing or removing items from the display shelf without paying—consistent with shoplifting behavior. Their posture is hunched, hands are near or inside the shelving unit, and they remain focused on the items while other customers move normally. No staff intervention is visible during this segment.
